text: By Listen (2 min) Insurance risks are growing as AI adoption spreads through the economy. Jung Yeon-Je / AFP / Getty Images A string of artificial-intelligence safety incidents is exposing a gaping hole for the fast-growing industry: the lack of available insurance . Rogue agents have hacked into websites . AI chatbots have been accused of encouraging suicides and murders. An agent submitted fake unsolved murder tips . The latest episodes add to existing lawsuits AI companies face alleging chatbot harm and copyright violations when models are trained. Copyright © 2026 Dow Jones & Company, Inc.
